name: Performing Arts Season 2026/27
description: The fourth Performing Arts Season returns to the fundamental meaning of performing arts by connecting myths and rituals as origins of dance, theatre and performance. The season presents outstanding international productions, including Marina Abramović's Balkan Erotic Epic, Mario Banushi's MAMI, and other works that explore how contemporary performing arts can serve as something that connects us rather than divides, inspiring reverence for life and dignity.
